stdin_policy: Inherited trusted native stdin; neither observer nor capture reads it. No stdin file/device is created, opened or inspected.
native_continuations: Save every returned native object. If session_id is returned, use write_stdin with empty chars and tty false; no restart, no automatic retry. Do not confuse this with a hard deadline.
separate_streams: Exclusive ordinary files, never a merged preview. Source and exact path/request review plus explicit single-probe authorization must precede allocation.
receipt: Independent recipient must receive full raw streams, native/session returns, immutable source/binding pins and absence/key evidence. Exit zero is not acceptance.
note: Literal choices only; command remains null and gates remain unconditional. No enabled capture or probe is granted.
